_comment: WHO DOES THE WORK, as a role rather than a person.
Every workflow stage in workflows.json names an owner from this list. The
point is assignment without hard-coding an employee: a studio of three
people fills six roles, a studio of twelve fills the same six, and neither
arrangement changes a workflow. A named person belongs in whatever system
eventually assigns the work, not in the definition of the work.
`external: true` marks a role that is NOT ours. The client is a role
because approval is a stage someone has to do, and pretending the studio
owns it would let a scheduler promise a duration it cannot control.
`automatable` is a property of the ROLE, not a promise about any stage: it
says whether an agent could stand in for this role at all. A stage is only
a candidate for automation when its own automationPotential says so AND

description.en: Decides what the work is trying to achieve and writes the direction the rest of the stages execute against.
description.ar: يقرّر ما الذي يحاول العمل تحقيقه، ويكتب الاتجاه الذي تنفّذ بقية المراحل وفقه.

description.en: Produces original visual work: concepts, identity systems and the assets built from them.
description.ar: ينتج العمل البصري الأصلي: المفاهيم وأنظمة الهوية والأصول المبنية عليها.

description.en: Builds, tests and releases anything that runs — sites, pages, integrations and the environments they live in.
description.ar: يبني ويختبر ويطلق كل ما يعمل فعليًا — المواقع والصفحات والتكاملات والبيئات التي تعمل فيها.

description.en: Writes the words: captions, ad copy, documents and anything that has to read correctly in both languages.
description.ar: يكتب النصوص: التعليقات ونصوص الإعلانات والمستندات وكل ما يجب أن يُقرأ صحيحًا باللغتين.

description.en: Runs shoots and post-production: photography, videography, editing and delivery of the finished footage.
description.ar: يدير التصوير وما بعد الإنتاج: التصوير الفوتوغرافي والفيديو والمونتاج وتسليم المواد النهائية.

description.en: Runs the accounts on their cycle: scheduling, publishing, monitoring and community work.
description.ar: يدير الحسابات وفق دورتها: الجدولة والنشر والمتابعة والتفاعل مع المجتمع.

description.en: Owns paid campaigns end to end: setup, targeting, spend, optimisation and what the numbers mean.
description.ar: يملك الحملات المدفوعة من البداية إلى النهاية: الإعداد والاستهداف والإنفاق والتحسين وقراءة الأرقام.

description.en: Checks the work against its own quality checks before a client sees it, and is never the person who made it.
description.ar: يفحص العمل مقابل معايير جودته قبل أن يراه العميل، ولا يكون أبدًا الشخص الذي أنجزه.

description.en: Holds the relationship: briefs in, presentations out, approvals chased, handover confirmed.
description.ar: يمسك بالعلاقة: استلام الإحاطات وتقديم العروض ومتابعة الموافقات وتأكيد التسليم.

description.en: The person paying for the work. Owns every stage that is a decision rather than a task — approvals, choices and sign-off.
description.ar: الشخص الذي يدفع مقابل العمل. يملك كل مرحلة هي قرار لا مهمة — الموافقات والاختيارات والاعتماد النهائي.
